text:
trevor: Hey team — quick one from my DC trip last week. Submitted hotel expense but the system auto-applied a GSA per-diem rate ($96/night) instead of the actual charge on my folio ($180/night). Looks like the hotel posted a GSA line item and our parser picked it up. Can we get an adjustment? I paid on my corporate card (ending 4321). Link to folio: https://files.redwood.xyz/folios/trevor-dc-2026.pdf :thinking:

maria-finance: @trevor thanks for flagging. Can you attach the itemized folio (room + taxes + incidentals) and the card statement showing the $180 charge? If the folio explicitly shows a GSA rate line we need the hotel folio + manager approval to override. Also confirm the dates.

trevor: attached the folio (same link above) — dates 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12. The folio shows an itemized 'GSA RATE' line but the room charge posted at $180 on the corpcard transaction. I did an early check-in upgrade (paid at front desk) — happy to get manager signoff.

finance-bot: Expense #EXP-29641 received. Status: action required — documentation missing. Please attach manager approval or a brief note in the expense thread.

jordan: @trevor I can approve the exception for the additional amount — this was a meet with the product team and the early check-in was needed. Trevor, can you paste a one-line approval here so finance has it on record? :+1:

trevor: jordan — approved for the difference. Jordan provided verbal/Slack approval for early check-in and upgrade.

emily: @maria-finance quick Q — do we need a separate vendor invoice showing the $180 posted, or is the corpcard charge + folio sufficient?

maria-finance: corpcard charge + folio should be sufficient if manager approval is attached to the expense. We just need to confirm it's not a billing error from the hotel (e.g., mistakenly labeled GSA). If hotel refunds the GSA line we can't reimburse twice, so we'll hold until it's reconciled.

trevor: understood. I pinged the hotel to confirm (they said the GSA line was for a negotiated rate but my card was charged the public rate for late check-in). Waiting on their email, will forward.

maria-finance: OK — next steps: 1) update the expense to include Jordan's approval (copy/paste is fine), 2) attach corpcard statement showing the $180 charge, 3) forward any hotel email if they confirm. Once those are in, we'll process an adjustment for the difference (expect within 2 pay cycles). Note policy: claims older than 60 days may need manager exec signoff.

trevor: done — I've added Jordan's approval text and attached the card charge screenshot. Hotel confirmed by email and I forwarded it to expenses@redwood.com. :thumbsup:

maria-finance: Got everything, thanks. I'll queue the adjustment and update you here if they issue a refund or if we need to reverse anything. Processing ETA: 2 pay cycles. :white_check_mark:

finance-bot: Expense #EXP-29641 status updated: documentation complete, queued for payment adjustment.
